mapper.select: SELECT mc.mock_card_id AS mockCardId, mc.card_id AS cardId FROM mock_card mc INNER JOIN card c ON c.card_id = mc.card_id INNER JOIN card_company cc ON cc.card_company_id = c.card_company_id WHERE mc.card_number = #{cardNumber} AND mc.is_active = 'Y' AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND cc.is_active = 'Y' LIMIT 1
